text:
Pakistan extends its warm felicitations to the European Union and its Member States on Europe Day.

We value our longstanding partnership with the EU, grounded in mutual respect, shared values, and a commitment to peace, prosperity, and sustainable development.
translated_text:
巴基斯坦在欧洲日向欧盟及其成员国表示热烈祝贺。

我们重视与欧盟的长期伙伴关系，这种伙伴关系建立在相互尊重、共同价值观以及对和平、繁荣和可持续发展的承诺的基础上。

text: "We just hit somebody": Audio captures the moment a Frontier plane hit a pedestrian on a runway before a takeoff in Denver.

text: The U.S. labor market continued to defy expectations in April, with employers surpassing economists' forecasts and adding 115,000 jobs nationwide.

text: The United States government is sending a repatriation plane to safely evacuate 17 Americans from the cruise ship dealing with a deadly hantavirus outbreak. They will be taken to the University of Nebraska Medical Center, which has a special biocontainment unit, upon their return
translated_text: 美国政府正在派遣一架遣返飞机，从正在爆发致命汉坦病毒的游轮上安全撤离 17 名美国人。他们返回后将被带到内布拉斯加大学医学中心，该中心设有特殊的生物防护装置

text: The U.S. Treasury Department on Friday announced a new round of sanctions against 10 individuals and companies it accused of helping enable Iran's drone and ballistic missile programs.

text:
Three hikers who were in an off-limits area died Friday in an eruption of Indonesia's Mount Dukono volcano, officials said.

The eruption on Halmahera island sent an ash cloud about 6 miles into the air, but no towns or villages were close enough to face any immediate threat.
translated_text:
官员称，周五，三名在禁区徒步旅行者因印度尼西亚杜科诺火山喷发而死亡。

哈马黑拉岛的火山喷发将火山灰喷向约 6 英里的空中，但没有任何城镇或村庄距离足够近，无法面临任何直接威胁。

text: SUNDAY: Sen. Mark Kelly (D-AZ) joins us to discuss the latest on his legal battle with the Trump administration’s Department of Defense over a video in which he and other lawmakers told U.S. servicemembers they could disobey “illegal orders.” Tune in at 10:30 am ET.
translated_text: 周日：参议员马克·凯利（民主党-亚利桑那州）与我们一起讨论他与特朗普政府国防部之间的法律斗争的最新情况，因为他和其他议员在一段视频中告诉美国军人他们可以违反“非法命令”。请于东部时间上午 10:30 收听。

text:
The Pentagon released 162 files related to UFOs and UAPs on Friday, including eyewitness testimony, photos, videos and reports of sightings of unexplained objects, dating back decades from around the globe.  

The new UFO website comes in response to an order from President Trump
